en.answer: Since the effects that treat the cards' names as "<<6390>>" are not applying while they are in the Deck, you can Special Summon both at the same time using <<13527>>.
en.question: Both <<10866>> and <<13723>> treat their name as "<<6390>>" while on the field. Can both of these monsters be Special Summoned at the same time using <<13527>>, which must Special Summon two monsters with different names from each other?
en.title: Can I use <<13527>> to Special Summon both <<10866>> and <<13723>>?

ja.answer: デッキではカード名を「<<6390>>」として扱う効果は適用されませんので、「<<13527>>」の効果によって「<<13723>>」と「<<10866>>」をそれぞれ特殊召喚できます。
ja.question: フィールドでカード名を「<<6390>>」として扱う「<<13723>>」と「<<10866>>」を、「<<13527>>」の効果によってデッキから特殊召喚できますか？
